questions_asked: Does the tuner reliably detect no-overshoot + ends on target ±0.2°C for 60sec?

verdict.Q1_no_overshoot_plus_0_2C_60s_hold: NO — acceptance gate uses ±0.5°C band with no 60s tail-hold; the 0.2°C/60s logic exists only in suggest_gains and never gates acceptance
verdict.Q2_ki_tuning_reliable: WEAK — accepted runs never receive Ki adjustment; the 60s-hold metric is total in-band fraction (not consecutive tail); Ki is frozen on high-variance runs

bugs.title: acceptance_ok enforces ±0.5°C, not ±0.2°C; zero 60s-hold check
evidence: No line in acceptance_ok checks for 60 consecutive seconds in-band
bugs.impact: A run that ends at 91.5°C (0.5°C droop) is ACCEPTED. The ±0.2°C / 60s goal is never enforced at the acceptance gate.
bugs.fix: In config.yaml, set max_final_error_c=0.2 and band_c=0.2. Add a min_tail_stable_s=60 field. In acceptance_ok, call wait_stable(samples, band_c=0.2, window=60) and verify the stable timestamp is within the last 60s of the recording. Pass raw samples into acceptance_ok (currently it only receives RunMetrics).

bugs.title: 60s-hold in suggest_gains counts scattered in-band dwell, not consecutive tail
evidence: If duration=300s and in_band_fraction=0.21, actual_stable_seconds=63 — PASSES the 60s gate
But those 63 seconds could be scattered rebound peaks anywhere in the recording
metrics.py:163-173  wait_stable / is_stable already exist with band_c and window params — NOT called from suggest_gains
bugs.impact: A system that bounces through ±0.5°C band 21% of the time over 300s is declared to have 'held target for 60s'. Ki is prematurely declared converged. The tail could still be drifting.
bugs.fix: Add a tail_stable_s field to RunMetrics. In score_run (runner.py:165 call site), compute tail_stable_s = wait_stable(samples, band_c=0.2, window=60). In suggest_gains, replace the in_band_fraction multiply with: held_target_for_60s = (metrics.tail_stable_s is not None and metrics.tail_stable_s >= metrics.duration_s - 60).

bugs.title: Ki is never adjusted on accepted runs — acceptance fires before Ki converges to ±0.2°C
evidence: runner.py:364-368  if accepted: state.mark_completed(); return gains  — suggest_gains never called
config.yaml acceptance.max_final_error_c=0.5 — 0.4°C droop is accepted without Ki adjustment
suggest_gains.py:122  Ki increase path only reached when run is REJECTED (final_error < -0.15)
bugs.impact: Dominant reason Ki under-tunes: ladder exits a scenario the moment Kp/Kd transient looks clean, even if steady-state offset is 0.4°C. Ki has had no chance to accumulate.
bugs.fix: BUG-1 fix (tightening max_final_error_c to 0.2) is the cleanest cure — acceptance won't fire until Ki has done its job. Alternatively, after an accepted run, call suggest_gains once for Ki-only (skip Kp/Kd) and apply if Ki changed materially.

bugs.title: ct_variance_in_band uses ±0.5°C window — is_welded_to_target check is too loose
evidence: Variance < 0.05 is achievable over ±0.5°C window even when system is oscillating ±0.3°C
bugs.impact: is_welded_to_target passes too easily. Ki increase loop terminates before tight flatline is achieved.
bugs.fix: Add a second variance field ct_variance_tight_c computed with band_c=0.2 in score_run. Use this in is_welded_to_target: ct_variance_in_band < 0.02 (tighter threshold for ±0.2°C window).

bugs.title: No unit tests for Ki tuning paths — all regressions are silent
evidence: test_ladder.py SuggestGainsTest: only 2 tests — test_overshoot_reduces_kp, test_severe_overshoot_does_not_compound
Zero coverage of: Ki droop increase, Ki float decrease, Ki kickstart from 0.001, TARGET MET path, scattered-in-band false-hold (BUG-2 regression)
bugs.impact: Any Ki fix can silently regress with no test failure.
bugs.fix: Add 5 tests: (1) final_error=-0.2 droop after 150s → Ki increases; (2) final_error=+0.2 float → Ki decreases; (3) Ki=0.001 droop → kickstart to 0.015; (4) tail_stable_s covers final 60s → TARGET MET; (5) scattered in-band (in_band_fraction=0.21 over 300s, tail unstable) → Ki still adjusts (not prematurely locked).

not_a_bug: accept checks in_band_fraction >= 0.3 — correctly rejects grazing runs
accept checks frozen_samples <= 3 — correct transient tolerance
suggest_gains overshoot tiers are mutually exclusive (severe does not compound into high) — fixed and tested
Ki kickstart from near-zero (0.001 → 0.015) is correctly handled at suggest_gains.py:124

context_snapshots.acceptance_ok: runner.py:121-135 — checks max_overshoot_c, time_to_band_s, in_band_fraction, frozen_samples, final_error_c (all from config.acceptance, which uses 0.5°C thresholds). No 60s-hold check.
context_snapshots.suggest_gains_60s_check: suggest_gains.py:105-148 — actual_stable_seconds = metrics.in_band_fraction * metrics.duration_s (BUG-2). is_welded_to_target checks final_error <=0.15 and ct_variance_in_band < 0.05 (BUG-4).
context_snapshots.Ki_adjustment_path: suggest_gains.py:120-141 — Ki increased only when final_error < -0.15 (droop), decreased when > +0.15 (float), held when variance issue.
